_doc: The owner's hold on mods in the Maturation Pipeline (mod_owner_hold.py; item RIMMANDRAKE_HOLD_SIX_BIOME_MODS_ONLY_PYRELANDS_STAYS). A mod listed here: the Dispatch tick launches nothing on it, the Designer and DesignerCodex chain sweeps and run-now launches skip it, it raises no stall, idle or incident alarm, and every status names it HELD BY OWNER with his words and date. A run already live on it is allowed to finish. Only he lifts a hold: `python3 src/RimMandrake/rimflow/mod_owner_hold.py lift <Mod> --said "<his words>"`, then publish this file. Ruling: design/RimMandrake/standing_rulings.md §Owner hold.
